methods.name: ramp_shepp
methods.desc: FBP, Paganin 1000 + unsharp 1.2/4; ramp window: Shepp-Logan, sinc(x) (x in cycles / pixel)

methods.name: ramp_cosine
methods.desc: FBP, Paganin 1000 + unsharp 1.2/4; ramp window: cosine, cos(pi x) (x in cycles / pixel)

methods.name: ramp_hann
methods.desc: FBP, Paganin 1000 + unsharp 1.2/4; ramp window: Hann, (1 + cos(pi x / p0)) / 2, cutoff p0 = 0.5 (x in cycles / pixel)

methods.name: ramp_hamming
methods.desc: FBP, Paganin 1000 + unsharp 1.2/4; ramp window: Hamming, 0.54 + 0.46 cos(pi x / p0), cutoff p0 = 0.5 (x in cycles / pixel)

methods.name: ramp_parzen
methods.desc: FBP, Paganin 1000 + unsharp 1.2/4; ramp window: Parzen, (1 - |x| / p0)^3, cutoff p0 = 0.5 (x in cycles / pixel)

methods.name: ramp_butterworth
methods.desc: FBP, Paganin 1000 + unsharp 1.2/4; ramp window: Butterworth, half amplitude at p0 = 0.5, order 8 (x in cycles / pixel)
